messages:
mira: XenonAnalytics wants to run 3 simultaneous POCs and asks if we can stack credits and later roll into one enterprise commit if they convert within 75 days. They also want the credits to be assignable across teams.
oz: Assignable across legal entities is a hard no by default. We can allow stacking only if the POCs bill to the same billing account.
felix: Deal Desk: we can offer consolidation with explicit SOW mapping and a stacking cap. Recommend default STACK_CAP=2, exceptions require approval + exec sign-off.
tara: Ops note: prefer meter+credit so we retain telemetry. If they want "no metering" it complicates capacity planning.
mira: Customer insists credits be transferable between internal business units under the same parent corp. Is that doable?
oz: Transfer within same billing account is ok but must be captured in SOW and CSV mapping. Transfers across separate billing entities require new contracts.
revops-bot: For RevOps import, CSV schema: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,CREDIT_LIMIT,CONSOLIDATE_TO_COMMIT_ID. Upload with /deal-request.
felix: Draft SOW snippet to include in deal-request (draft):
```nBILLING_ENTITY=Xenon-Parent
POC_TAGS=XEN-POC-1,XEN-POC-2,XEN-POC-3
POC_WINDOWS=2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30;2026-06-01 to 2026-07-15;2026-06-15 to 2026-07-31
POC_CREDIT=100% metered usage credited up to $20k per POC
CONSOLIDATED_COMMIT=If conversion within 75d, apply up to $50k/mo for 12 months to consolidated commit
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=75d
STACK_CAP=2 active POCs per billing entity without Deal Desk exec approval
TRANSFER_RULES=Within-billing-entity transfers allowed with SOW mapping
```
legal-bot: Legal: credits timeboxed and auditable; no cash refunds for committed fees; require usage logs and right to audit before applying credits. Also tighten wording on "transferable" to "transferable between business units under the same BILLING_ENTITY only."
felix: Noted. I'll prepare the /deal-request and route to Legal. @mira please confirm billing_entity and attach estimated traffic + model SKUs.
mira: Will confirm with customer and attach CSV by EOD. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
